footprint.hotspots_body: Changed files that are historically churn-heavy

reviews.title: Hobit reviews
reviews.none_selected: No hobits reviewed this MR — pick reviewers when creating a review.
reviews.top_empty: No findings from the completed reviews — a good sign.
reviews.no_comments: Nothing to flag through this lens.

section.failed: This section failed to generate — try Re-analyze

principles.title: Principle checks
principles.intro: Ask the repository's principles about these changes specifically. A verdict here is about the diff — a rule this MR doesn't touch is upheld, and a violation that predates the branch is not reported.
principles.queued: Principle checks queued. Verdicts appear here as they land.
principles.checking_body: An auditor is reading the diff against this principle.
principles.never_body: Not checked against this MR yet.
principles.none_assigned: This repository isn't held to any enabled principles yet. Assign some on its Principles tab and they'll show up here.

remarks.star: Keep as a remark for this MR
remarks.intro: The findings you starred from the hobits and principles — this MR's curated shortlist. Remarks are snapshots, so they survive re-runs.
remarks.empty_body: Star the findings worth acting on in the other two tabs and they'll be collected here.
